meta.title: MediaVore — Local-first media tracker for Android
meta.description: Track movies, series, and books you have seen, read, or want to discover. No account, no server, 100% local on your device.

hero.tagline: Your personal library for movies, series, and books — stored locally, without accounts or tracking.
hero.fallbackNote: Direct link to the latest Android APK.

screens.heading: Designed like ink on paper
screens.subtitle: A calm, tactile interface that adapts automatically to light and dark mode.
screens.themeNote: Previews follow your system color scheme.

items.title: Your watchlist & seen history
items.caption: Organize movies, series, and books across custom lists with ratings and viewing dates.

items.title: Swipe to decide together
items.caption: Pick your next movie night solo or in Duo mode without endless scrolling.

items.title: Never miss a release
items.caption: Track upcoming movie premieres and next unwatched episodes with Quick Add.

items.title: Stats & achievements
items.caption: Unlock milestones for genres, streaks, and total watch time — all computed on-device.

features.heading: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.subtitle: Built to respect your privacy and stay fast offline.

items.title: Movies, series & books
items.description: Log what you have watched or read, rate titles, record dates, and keep a clean watchlist.

items.title: Custom lists & filters
items.description: Build ordered lists for every mood and filter by genre, language, or streaming provider.

items.title: Release alerts & Quick Add
items.description: Follow upcoming movies and next unwatched episodes, with one-tap suggestions from your history.

items.title: Stats & achievements
items.description: Explore your viewing habits, streaks, and genre milestones with built-in gamification.

items.title: Full local backup
items.description: Export and import your entire library in JSON — append, merge, or replace whenever you switch devices.

items.title: No account, no server
items.description: Your data never leaves your phone. No sign-up, no telemetry, and no subscription.

install.heading: Install on Android
install.subtitle: Three quick steps to get started.

steps.title: Download & install the APK
steps.description: Tap the download button above to get mediavore.apk. Open the file and allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser if prompted.

steps.title: Verify the SHA-256 checksum
steps.description: Compare the downloaded file against the official fingerprint below before installing.

steps.title: Add your TMDB API key
steps.description: On first launch, paste a free personal TMDB API key in Settings. MediaVore talks directly to TMDB from your device with no proxy server.

install.shaUnavailable: Available in the release notes on GitHub.
